> **Imagining other lives**
> 
> Psychologists have long been interested in counterfactual thinking — the habit of imagining how things might have turned out differently. It appears to be universal, emerging in children by about the age of four, and it has an obvious cost: dwelling on what might have been is strongly associated with regret.
> 
> Yet the ability seems to serve a purpose. In one well-known study, athletes who won bronze medals reported greater satisfaction than those who won silver. The silver medallists compared themselves with the winner and imagined victory; the bronze medallists compared themselves with fourth place and imagined missing out entirely. The same event produced opposite feelings depending on the alternative imagined.
> 
> Researchers distinguish between two kinds of counterfactual thought. Thinking “if only I had prepared better” can improve future behaviour. Thinking “if only I had been born luckier” cannot. The first is associated with better performance later; the second, with nothing except lower mood.

**Multiple choice (6–8):**

1. Counterfactual thinking appears in children by about
   A. age two B. age four C. age seven
1. Bronze medallists were more satisfied because they compared themselves with
   A. the gold medallist B. the silver medallist C. the person in fourth place
1. The useful kind of counterfactual thinking involves
   A. imagining better luck B. imagining different actions one could take C. avoiding comparison entirely

tu_cham.de:
Viết **80–90 từ** trả lời: *If you could change one thing about your city, what would it be?*
*Tiêu chí: điều kiện loại 2 đúng cấu trúc (3đ) · “If I were” dùng đúng (1đ) · có ≥1 câu “I wish” (1đ).*

1. What would you do if you won a large amount of money?
1. If you could live in another country, where would you choose?
1. Is there anything you wish you had learned earlier?

-----

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 80–90 từ trả lời: If you could change one thing about your city, what would it be?
writing.bai_mau: If I could change one thing about my city, I would improve public transport. If there were more metro lines, far fewer people would use motorbikes. The air would be cleaner and the streets would be much quieter. If I were in charge of planning, I would also add proper cycle lanes. Many people would cycle to work if they felt safe doing so. I wish this had been planned twenty years ago.

cham_diem.tieu_chi: Điều kiện loại 2 đúng cấu trúc (3đ)
cham_diem.vi_sao:
If I could change… I would improve · If there were more lines… fewer people would use · If I were in charge… I would add · Many people would cycle if they felt safe.
Mệnh đề if dùng quá khứ đơn, mệnh đề chính dùng would + V.
If I were in charge — dùng were cho mọi chủ ngữ trong điều kiện loại 2, kể cả I. Đây là dạng chuẩn trong văn viết.
I wish this had been planned — wish + quá khứ hoàn thành để nói tiếc về quá khứ.

dang_hoc: Điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, would + V. Nói về điều không thật ở hiện tại.
Với động từ to be, dùng were cho mọi chủ ngữ: If I were, if he were. "If I was" chỉ dùng trong khẩu ngữ.
Ba loại wish: wish + quá khứ đơn (tiếc hiện tại) · wish + could (mong làm được) · wish + quá khứ hoàn thành (tiếc quá khứ).
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ If I would have more time → ✅ If I had more time
❌ If I was you → ✅ If I were you (văn viết chuẩn)
❌ I wish I have more time → ✅ I wish I had more time

speaking.de_tom_tat: If you could change one thing about your job, what would it be? / What would you do with a year off? / If you could live anywhere, where?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: If you could change one thing about your job, what would it be?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I'd reduce the number of meetings. If we met half as often, we'd get far more done. Most decisions could be made over email.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Điều kiện loại 2 trong hội thoại: I'd reduce, if we met, we'd get. Rút gọn would thành 'd.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What would you do with a year off?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I'd probably study abroad for six months and travel for the rest. If I had that much time, I'd focus on English properly rather than fitting it around work.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "rather than" so sánh hai phương án — nâng điểm.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: If you could live anywhere, where would you choose?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Somewhere with four real seasons — Japan or perhaps Korea. If I lived somewhere cooler, I think I'd cycle every day.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Trả lời cụ thể (nêu tên nước) rồi giải thích bằng điều kiện loại 2.

cham_diem.vi_sao: if we met… we'd get · If I had… I'd focus · If I lived… I'd cycle.
Đủ, có lý do cụ thể.
I'd /aɪd/ · we'd /wiːd/ — rút gọn thành một âm tiết.

meo_noi: Khi nói, would luôn rút gọn thành 'd: I'd, we'd, they'd. Nói đủ "I would" nghe rất cứng.
Câu hỏi "If you could…" bắt buộc trả lời bằng would — đừng chuyển sang will.
